description: FP_01xx_Handbetaetigung_ohneVerschlussplatten is the drawing identifier for electrical enclosure component in Hensel's ENYSTAR enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An electrical enclosure component houses or supports part of an electrical assembly. A complete arrangement must also include the selected lid or door, internal mounting and cable-entry details.

For example, in an industrial junction enclosure beside a field cable route, use the FP_01xx_Handbetaetigung_ohneVerschlussplatten reference to coordinate lid or door access, mounting points and cable-entry faces. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.
